navaid.name: Ashbridge's Bay Gas Dock
navaid.description: Our convenient gas dock, located on the north side of club peninsula, has facilities for fueling and pump-out that are accessible to both members and the general boating public during ABYC’s sailing season, May – October.

navaid.name: U.S. Coast Guard - Station Niagara
navaid.description: U.S. Coast Guard Station Niagara's missions include Search and Rescue, Law Enforcement, Ice Rescue, Migrant Interdiction, Military Readiness, and Environmental Response. Area of responsibility is the Lower Niagara River and southwestern Lake Ontario.
